about.subtitle: of Success
about.description: Over 30 years since the company was established in 1991, Bangkok Modern Granite Co., Ltd. has been a manufacturer and distributor of marble and granite imported from abroad.
about.process: Starting from selecting raw materials from stone sources both domestically and internationally, to quality control to achieve work that meets customer needs. We can support all types of stone production from stone slabs, cut-to-size stones, handicraft products, including turning work, marble columns, and granite columns. We have 2 production facilities.

story.title: Our Story
story.section1Title: Starting from a stone processing factory of all kinds, up to the present, we have expanded our work in sculpture, architecture, portrait carving, creating what you dream of, crafting what you think, to come out exactly as desired.
story.concept: With the concept "Create Dreams With Stones", we carefully select quality stones from around the world, including Italy, Spain, Brazil, Zimbabwe, and India, to fulfill your dreams, whether for homes, condos, various offices, making them beautiful, elegant, luxurious, with the dream style you want. Because we are the leader in manufacturing and processing marble, granite, and other natural stones. We also have knowledge and understanding of all forms of stone processes with great expertise and long experience in stone work.
story.section2Title: Throughout the working period, BMG Bangkok Modern Granite
story.section2SubTitle: has gained trust and confidence from customers, both government and private sectors, creating many famous works, including exterior architectural decoration, Ubosot of Wat Sothorn Wararam Worawihan, Chedi of Wat Pa Phurithat Patipatharam, Wat Pa Dan Wiwek, Luang Ta Maha Bua Museum, Bangkok Gold flagship store, Erawan Hotel, FN Building Rama 9.
story.section3: Nationally recognized sculptural works include stupas and stone inscriptions at Wat Pa Dan Wiwek, carved stone portraits of Luang Pu Man Phurithatto, THE WISDOM OF MIND Somdet Phra Nyanaviroj at Wat Thammamongkol Thao Bun Nonthavihar, carved stone Buddha statues at Wat Suwannaphumi Buddhachayanti to surround over 1,000 stupas, the principal Buddha image in the Vipassana meditation room at Wat Nawamintararachutis in Boston, USA, Pi Seah, Khmer art elephant lions, European-style lions
story.oemServices: We also provide OEM product manufacturing services, stone products according to customer specifications with brand name engraving, ready-made stone products such as tables, clocks, The Echo coasters, or others. You can visit our online store. If you want to experience real pieces, you can visit all our works, including various production processes at our factory.
story.visionText: BMG Bangkok Modern Granite is ready to create pieces from the beginning of the process to delivery of work, with attention to every detail from over 30 years of experience, which not only meets and satisfies customers, but is also our pride in creating valuable works that will remain with Thailand forever.
story.missionText: BMG Bangkok Modern Granite is committed to developing work production technology to keep up with world changes by selecting modern production tools, ready to create works for customers that meet all needs, consistent with future needs.

products.title: Our Products
products.subtitle: Premium Natural Stone Collection
products.description: Discover our extensive collection of premium granite and marble sourced from the finest quarries around the world. Each stone is carefully selected for its quality, beauty, and durability.

graniteInfo.title: Premium Granite Collection
graniteInfo.description: Our granite selection features some of the world's most durable and beautiful stones. From the deep blacks of Zimbabwe to the warm browns of India, each granite variety offers unique characteristics perfect for countertops, flooring, and architectural applications.

marbleInfo.title: Exquisite Marble Selection
marbleInfo.description: Experience the timeless elegance of our marble collection. From the classic white Carrara used by Renaissance masters to modern designer stones, our marbles bring luxury and sophistication to any space.

wat-navamintararachuthit.title: Wat Nawamintararachutis
wat-navamintararachuthit.description: Buddha statue carved from marble in meditation posture. Made from White Thassos marble with a luminous quality resembling white jade. Installed on the 2nd floor of the Vipassana Meditation Center at Wat Nawamintararachutis, Massachusetts, United States.

wat-pa-klang-non-phu.title: Wat Pa Klang Non Phu
wat-pa-klang-non-phu.description: Buddha statue carved from marble in meditation posture. Made from Cloudy marble which has a non-glossy finish, light cream color, and a texture similar to limestone. Installed at Wat Pa Klang Non Phu, Sakon Nakhon Province.

wat-cholprathan-rangsrit.title: Wat Cholprathan Rangsrit
wat-cholprathan-rangsrit.description: Buddha statue carved from marble in Gandhara art style, blessing posture. Made from White Thassos marble with smooth polished surface and luminous quality resembling white jade. Installed on the 3rd floor of Panyanananda Memorial Building at Wat Cholprathan Rangsrit, Nonthaburi Province.

luang-pu-man.title: Luang Pu Man Phurithatto
luang-pu-man.location: Wat Pa Sutthawat, Sakon Nakhon Province
luang-pu-man.description: Marble portrait sculpture of Luang Pu Man Phurithatto from Wat Pa Sutthawat, Ubon Ratchathani Province. Carved from White Carrara marble with smooth, non-glossy finish, life-size proportions.

luang-ta-maha-bua.title: Luang Ta Maha Bua Ñanasampanno
luang-ta-maha-bua.location: Wat Ketkesi Sikhun, Udon Thani Province
luang-ta-maha-bua.description: Marble portrait sculpture of Luang Ta Maha Bua Ñanasampanno from Wat Ketkesi Sikhun, Udon Thani Province. Carved from White Carrara marble with smooth, non-glossy finish, life-size proportions.

luang-pu-kruba-wong.title: Luang Pu Kruba Wong
luang-pu-kruba-wong.location: Wat Phra Phutthabat Huai Tom, Lamphun Province
luang-pu-kruba-wong.description: Marble portrait sculpture of Luang Pu Kruba Wong from Wat Phra Phutthabat Huai Tom, Lamphun Province. Carved from White Carrara marble with smooth, non-glossy finish, life-size proportions.

luang-pho-sod.title: Luang Pho Sod Candasaro
luang-pho-sod.description: Marble portrait sculpture of Luang Pho Sod Candasaro from Wat Paknam, Phasi Charoen, Bangkok. Carved from White Carrara marble with smooth, non-glossy finish, life-size proportions.

mae-chi-tossaporn.title: Mae Chi Tossaporn
mae-chi-tossaporn.description: Marble portrait sculpture of Mae Chi Tossaporn located at Ban Phet Bampen, Phetchaburi Province. Carved from White Thassos marble with luminous quality resembling white jade, life-size proportions.

president-chusak.title: President Chusak Sricharoenlamsum
president-chusak.description: Marble portrait sculpture of President Chusak Sricharoenlamsum located at BMG Bangkok Modern Granite. Carved from White Carrara marble with smooth, non-glossy finish, life-size portrait.

wat-sothorn.title: Wat Sothorn Wararam Worawihan
wat-sothorn.description: New ordination hall built in adapted Rattanakosin style at Wat Sothorn Wararam Worawihan, Chachoengsao Province. Exterior wall decoration uses White Carrara marble from Italy.

dharma-museum.title: Dhamma Chedi Museum Phra Dhammavisuddhi Mongkol
dharma-museum.description: Luang Ta Phra Maha Bua Ñanasampanno, Udon Thani Province. Dhamma Chedi Museum Phra Dhammavisuddhi Mongkol.

wat-pa-amparo.title: Chantakaranusorn Museum
wat-pa-amparo.location: Wat Pa Amparo Panyawanaram, Chonburi Province

phra-that-buddha-ratana.title: Phra That Buddha Ratana Maha Mongkol Sculpture
phra-that-buddha-ratana.location: Wat Pa Dan Wiwek, Bueng Kan Province
phra-that-buddha-ratana.description: Carved from Kaothone granite with 5 tiers. Each tier has Buddha's teachings engraved, with a lotus bud on top.

section1.title: General Information
section1.content1: Bangkok Modern Granite Co., Ltd. recognizes and respects privacy rights and places importance on managing personal data in accordance with the law. Therefore, we have prepared this Privacy Notice to inform data subjects about measures and practices for protecting personal data under the Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 and other related laws.
section1.content2: To ensure that our construction contracting, trading, import-export, and stone product manufacturing businesses, as well as business operations, protect your personal data properly and efficiently, Bangkok Modern Granite Co., Ltd. issues this Privacy Notice as follows:

section2.title: Definitions
section2.companyDef: means Bangkok Modern Granite Co., Ltd.
section2.personalDataDef: means data about individuals under the Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 and other related laws
section2.processingDef: means operations on personal data as defined by personal data protection laws or other related laws, such as collecting or receiving data, using data, organizing or storing, disclosing data, sending or transferring data, deleting or destroying or anonymizing personal data

section3.title: Methods of Collection and Receipt of Personal Data
section3.content: The Company primarily provides services to agencies or organizations, which means business data such as business information, transactions, payment history, and contact with the Company are considered juristic person data and not personal data under data protection law definitions. However, the Company may collect or receive your personal data when agencies or organizations appoint you as a representative to coordinate and conduct business with the Company on behalf of your agency or organization, including collecting personal data necessary for organizational management. The Company collects and receives your personal data through the following channels:

row1.business: Import trade and stone product manufacturing
row1.channel: Collected directly from data subjects through Company contact channels

section3.note: The Company does not intend to serve minors as a target group or employ them as employees or workers, and does not collect or receive special categories of personal data (per Section 26 of the Personal Data Protection Act) for use or processing in business operations. If the Company needs to process your special categories of personal data in the future, the Company will request your explicit consent electronically or in writing before or during the collection or receipt of such special categories of personal data, unless such collection or receipt falls under exceptions specified by personal data protection law or other laws.

section4.title: Purposes of Personal Data Processing
section4.content: The collection, use, and disclosure of your personal data will be carried out by the Company only as necessary and in accordance with personal data protection law requirements. The Company, as a data controller under personal data protection law, collects, uses, and discloses your personal data with the following details:

group.value: Representatives of agencies or organizations who coordinate and conduct business with the Company

purpose.label: Purpose/Reason the Company needs to collect or use your personal data:
purpose.value: To contact and coordinate necessary communications, business dealings, request additional information, or respond to inquiries

types.label: Types of personal data the Company collects:
types.value: Identification data including name, surname, ID card/passport number and information appearing on ID card or passport. Contact information including address, phone number, fax number, email, social media channels, or other electronic contact information

legal.label: Legal basis allowing the Company to process your personal data:

disclosure.label: To whom does the Company disclose your personal data:

retention.label: Personal data retention period:
retention.value: Stored for 1 year and anonymized immediately when no longer necessary

section5.title: Your Rights Regarding Personal Data
section5.content: Data subjects have rights under personal data protection law, and the Company places utmost importance on caring for and facilitating you as a data subject in requesting or exercising these rights under the rules, procedures, and conditions specified by personal data protection law as follows:

notification.title: Right to be informed
notification.desc: The Company will notify you of the "Privacy Notice" with clear details and disclose it to you through the website or official Company communication channels

withdrawal.title: Right to withdraw consent
withdrawal.desc: You can request to withdraw consent previously given to the Company

access.title: Right to access data
access.desc: You can request details about your personal data and request copies of personal data (there may be fees for data preparation) as well as request the Company to disclose how such data was obtained

correction.title: Right to rectification
correction.desc: You can request to update and correct incorrect personal data to ensure such data is accurate, current, and not misleading

deletion.title: Right to erasure
deletion.desc: You can request the Company to delete, destroy, or anonymize personal data

transfer.title: Right to data portability
transfer.desc: You can request copies of your personal data and request transfer of such data to another data controller (when technically feasible and there may be operational costs)

suspension.title: Right to restrict processing
suspension.desc: You can request the Company to restrict the use of personal data and request retention of such personal data for establishing legal claims, compliance with or exercise of legal claims, or defense against legal claims

objection.title: Right to object to processing
objection.desc: You can object to the processing of personal data

section5.note: In some cases, the Company may refuse the above requests if there are lawful grounds or for any operations for purposes or cases required by law or court orders, or cases that may impact and cause damage to the rights or freedoms of data subjects or other persons

section6.title: Security Measures for Personal Data
section6.content: The Company has implemented security measures for personal data. Examples of security measures and management for protecting personal data that the Company uses include:

access.title: Access Control
access.desc: By limiting access to your personal data from employees, officers, or internal personnel of the Company and unauthorized persons, both physically and through authentication mechanisms to prevent your personal data from being used, disclosed, destroyed, or accessed without authorization

training.title: Training and awareness for employees, officers, or internal personnel
training.desc: To create awareness and understanding of operational procedures for protecting personal data and handling problems or personal data breach incidents

dpo.title: Appointment of Data Protection Officer and establishment of personal data protection work processes
dpo.desc: To support the legal duties of the Data Protection Officer, coordinate with data subjects and relevant government officials as required by law

section7.title: Updates to the Privacy Notice
section7.content: The Company will review this Privacy Notice annually or when necessary or when personal data protection laws or technology changes to ensure the Company's personal data protection measures are effective and comply with laws, standards, or international measures related to personal data protection. The Company will notify you every time the Privacy Notice is updated by publishing the notice on the Company website

section8.title: Contact Channels
section8.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Notice or wish to exercise your rights as specified in this Privacy Notice, you can contact the Company through the Data Protection Officer at:
section8.address: Address: 9/11 Moo 10 Borommaratchachonnani Road, Sala Thammasop, Thawi Watthana, Bangkok 10170

section9.content: This Privacy Notice shall be effective from May 31, 2022

section1.title: Introduction
section1.content: Bangkok Modern Granite Co., Ltd. ("the Company") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data in compliance with the Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (PDPA) of Thailand and other applicable laws.

section2.title: Collection of Personal Data
section2.content: We collect only the personal data necessary for our business operations, such as: Identification information (name, surname, ID card or passport details), Contact details (address, phone number, email, social media accounts), Employment-related information (for employees, job applicants, or contractors). Sensitive personal data will not be collected unless required by law and with your explicit consent.

section3.title: Purpose of Use
section3.content: Your personal data may be used for:
purposes: Human resources management, including employment and contracting

section4.title: Disclosure of Personal Data
section4.content: We will not disclose your personal data to third parties unless required by law, or unless you have provided explicit consent.

section5.title: Your Rights
section5.content: Under the PDPA, you have the following rights:
rights: Right to access and obtain a copy of your personal data
Right to request correction or update of your data
Right to request deletion or anonymization of your data
Right to object to data processing

section6.title: Data Security
section6.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to safeguard personal data against unauthorized access, use, disclosure, alteration, or destruction.

section7.title: Updates to this Notice
section7.content: This Privacy Notice may be updated from time to time. Any changes will be published on our official website.
